column2: Paste this before every battleboard art direction: "Stylized fantasy card-game battle background, painterly digital art with clean bold shapes and soft cel-shaded lighting, matching a whimsical young-adult indie RPG card game, rich saturated colors with warm key light and colored shadows. A high-angle view looking down at a themed playing surface (table, floor, mat, or arena ground). The CENTER 60% of the image is calm, low-contrast, evenly lit, and uncluttered so cards placed on it stay readable. The opponent's side is the top half and the player's side is the bottom half, balanced and roughly mirror-symmetric. Thematic decorative detail is concentrated around the outer edges and corners, with a subtle vignette. Keep important details away from the very top and bottom 10% (the image will be cropped to 16:9). No text, letters, numbers, cards, UI, or characters in the center, no border. 3:2 landscape, 1536x1024."

Save each image as its Battleboard ID (e.g. BB-HOG.png). The game uses the zone's battleboard for overworld battles in that zone, and the dungeon's battleboard for every battle inside that dungeon. Boss battles can use a special board where listed.

column3: The Graveyard scripted encounter in the main town

A smooth mossy cave floor seen from above as the playing surface, with glowing crystals, curling roots, ferns, mushrooms, and fireflies around the edges and a soft green-blue glow.

A huge outdoor wooden lifting platform with chalk marks as the playing surface, on a sunny hillside; around the edges: boulder weights, log barbells, a giant hamster wheel, a mill, a torn glowing portal in one corner, and floating islands in the sky at the top edge.

column4: Spooky office bureaucracy, gray with sickly green
column5: A giant leather desk blotter on an enormous old office desk as the playing surface; around the edges: stacks of paperwork, rubber stamps, an inkwell, a ghostly coffee mug, paper clips, a flickering green desk lamp, and wisps of ghostly mist.

column4: Whimsical giant food world, warm and appetizing

A flat patch of packed earth ringed by old tires and planted with wildflowers as the playing surface; around the edges: junk piles overgrown with moss, a rusty car planter, hay bales, a compost heap, goats and raccoons peeking in, golden-hour light.

A cracked, dusty stone road as the playing surface; around the edges: dead trees, broken carts, abandoned checkpoint barriers, ash drifting in the air, and glowing purple magical rifts tearing through the corners, under a gray sickly sky.

A black rubber gym floor with chalk lines and a painted circle as the playing surface; around the edges: chained marble columns, regime banners, racks of iron weights, trophy statues, and in one corner a glimpse of bare gray prison stone.

A gleaming stainless-steel kitchen counter as the playing surface; around the edges: bubbling beakers of sauce, blueprints, measuring tools, copper pots, a half-built cannon made of a blender, and sickly-glowing corrupted ingredients in jars.

column3: The Hall of Final Approvals (all battles)

A flat mat of tightly woven glowing roots as the playing surface; around the edges: mutated glowing fungi, thorny vines, purple-green spores drifting, a pulsing corrupted flower, and pieces of junk being swallowed by growth.

column5: A polished gold-and-white parquet floor as the playing surface; around the edges: tall gilded mirrors, portraits of a smiling ruler, marble pillars, perfect flower vases, and thin glowing cracks creeping in from the corners.
